title: Private Sandbar Charter & Island Escape in Key West
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the crystal-clear waters and pristine sandbar islands that surround the Florida Keys. This private sandbar charter is fully customizable—whether you’re looking to relax with a drink in hand, explore the local marine sanctuary, or simply enjoy a laid-back day on the water.

Your captain will tailor the experience to your preferences, taking you to the best sandbar spots and providing everything you need for a carefree day in paradise. Enjoy sunshine, calm waters, and unforgettable views of Key West’s natural beauty.

This is the ultimate way to experience the islands—your day, your way, in the heart of the Florida Keys.
